clue.text: Up-to date statement you can bank on

definitions.meaning: a statement of what is happening now, current news
an everyday bank account for day-to-day money, literally something held at a bank

explanation.surface: A trustworthy report of the latest news.
explanation.definitionFit: Read one way the phrase is a report of present events; read the other it is the ordinary cheque-paying bank account.

clue.text: A bird for Ian, the rogue

parts.note: the ruff is a wading bird
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone calls Ian a bird and a rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruffian is a violent, lawless person, a synonym for a rogue.

clue.text: No longer acting as a Yeoman officer

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
on means performing, on stage

explanation.surface: A Yeoman of the Guard officer who has retired from duty.
explanation.walkthrough: The Yeomen of the Guard are a British royal bodyguard; an exon is one of their junior officers.
explanation.definitionFit: Exon is the title of a junior officer in the Yeomen of the Guard, a crossword-friendly rank.

clue.text: Hellish place for two sailors from America

indicators.note: two asks for the sailors word to be written twice

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: Two American sailors find a hellish place.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartarus is the abyss of the Greek underworld where the wicked are punished, a hell.

clue.text: Councillor takes fish out of baskets

parts.note: eels are fish

explanation.surface: A local councillor lifts fish from the baskets.
explanation.definitionFit: Creels are wicker baskets used by anglers to carry their catch.

clue.text: Isolated and in a very precarious position

definitions.meaning: exposed to danger, like someone at the end of a tree branch

explanation.surface: Someone left alone in a risky spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a person who has taken a lone, unsupported stance and so is both alone and at risk.

clue.text: Variety of robinia in Africa

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters of robinia are rearranged

explanation.surface: A kind of robinia tree grows in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Nairobi is the capital city of Kenya, a place found in Africa.

clue.text: Dramatic irresolution by a mountaineer?

definitions.meaning: a story ending left unresolved to keep the audience in suspense
humorously, a climber who hangs from a cliff

explanation.surface: Suspense supplied by a climber.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspenseful unresolved ending is a serial's standard device; literally a climber hanging from rock fits the second reading.

clue.text: Obviously relating to the scholastic schedule

definitions.meaning: belonging to a school or college course of study

explanation.surface: Plainly something to do with the school timetable.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means certainly in speech, and literally describes something pertaining to a programme of study.

clue.text: In southern Austria lawbreakers get a hearing

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the southern end of Austria running on into the next word

explanation.surface: Criminals in the south of Austria face a court hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial is a judicial hearing of a case in court.

clue.text: Disadvantaged worker and I excelled

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker
taken as written
capped means outdid, surpassed

explanation.surface: A worker and I outdid others despite drawbacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Handicapped means held back by a disadvantage, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Type of rain drop?

definitions.meaning: polluted rain with a low pH
slang for LSD, a drug taken in a drop or tab

explanation.surface: A question about a particular kind of rain falling.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid rain is the polluted kind; acid is also slang for LSD, which is dropped.

clue.text: Declining to let fellow organise golf final

indicators.note: to organise is to arrange, so the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone lets a fellow arrange the golf final.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling off means decreasing or dropping away, the same as declining.

clue.text: Loyal to one's class, as expected

definitions.meaning: faithful to one's form, the British school word for a class
behaving in the usual, predictable way

explanation.surface: A person faithful to their class, as predicted.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a form is a class of pupils, giving the punning first sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means acting in one's characteristic way, and literally faithful to one's school form.

clue.text: Old coin requires study by old heretic

parts.note: a den is a private study room
Arius was a fourth-century priest condemned as a heretic

explanation.surface: An antique coin needs study alongside an ancient heretic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just places the heretic beside the study.
explanation.definitionFit: The denarius was a silver coin of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Toboggan made by Giles and Henry

indicators.note: something made is fashioned anew, so the name's letters are reformed

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Two people build a toboggan together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Giles and Henry' look like two toboggan builders; 'made' is the anagram signal, and Henry is the electrical unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleigh is a sledge for travelling over snow, much like a toboggan.

clue.text: Register a demand for bread?

definitions.meaning: a calling out of names to check attendance
humorously, calling for a roll of bread

explanation.surface: A request to sign up for a loaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll call is the reading of a register; a call for a bread roll gives the joke.

clue.text: He prepares to shoot a hunting dog

definitions.meaning: one who cocks a gun ready to fire
a spaniel bred for flushing game

explanation.surface: A gun dog and its handler readying a shot.
explanation.definitionFit: A cocker spaniel is a gun dog; literally someone who cocks a gun is about to fire.

clue.text: Bawdy ballad uttered by a buccaneer

indicators.note: spoken out, so the words are said aloud

parts.note: coarse means bawdy and an air is a ballad or tune

explanation.surface: A pirate sings a rude song.
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair is a pirate, especially of the Barbary coast, the same as a buccaneer.

clue.text: Punctilious in producing preservative

parts.note: formal means correct and precise, punctilious
taken as written

explanation.surface: Being precise when making a preserving fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: Formalin is a formaldehyde solution used to preserve biological specimens.

clue.text: Quick examination of two watches

parts.note: look and see both mean watch
look and see both mean watch

explanation.surface: Glancing at a pair of wristwatches.
explanation.definitionFit: A look-see is informal for a brief inspection or glance.

clue.text: Suddenly attacked Socialist without assistance

indicators.note: without here means outside, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: a red is a socialist or communist
aid means assistance

explanation.surface: A socialist launched an attack alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but in its older sense means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Raided means made a sudden attack on, as police or soldiers do.

clue.text: Fellow in biblical tale deserving of forgiveness

indicators.note: in puts the fellow inside the biblical tale

parts.note: a parable is a story told by Jesus
a don is a university fellow

explanation.surface: A man in a Bible story who deserves forgiveness, like the prodigal son.
explanation.definitionFit: Pardonable means excusable, able to be forgiven.

clue.text: Sweetheart, that means nothing

definitions.meaning: zero, as in a tennis score

explanation.surface: Someone tells a darling they are worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is a term of endearment and also means nil in tennis scoring.

clue.text: Guinness, beer and cider to start with

parts.note: ale is beer

indicators.note: to start with picks the opening letter of cider

explanation.surface: A pub order: Guinness, ale and some cider first.
explanation.walkthrough: Guinness looks like the stout, but it is the actor Sir Alec Guinness.
explanation.definitionFit: Alec is the first name of the actor Sir Alec Guinness, so the surname clues the forename.

clue.text: Er eadgear, love, providing the poetic inspiration

clue.text: It's useless to publish fatality figures

definitions.text: It's useless to publish fatality figures

parts.words: It's useless to publish fatality figures
parts.note: a worthless thing described as if it were releasing a count of deaths in a disaster

explanation.surface: Releasing casualty statistics serves no purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead loss is something or someone completely useless, and literally a tally of the dead.

clue.text: The French elite

parts.note: the very best, expressed by a phrase in French meaning cream of the cream

explanation.surface: France's upper crust.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase literally means cream of the cream and is used in English for the very best people.
